method: planar rectangle 10 × 10 thickened by 2 mm along the normal: solid V = A × t = 100 × 2 = 200; centre at (5, 5, 1). The source surface body remains beside the solid.
note: surface.patch leaves Sheet; surface.thicken adds Slab. Volume and COM are of the solid only (surface volume is zero). The oracle STEP round-trip exports the solid only when an open sheet remains beside it.
